item.title: Middle East Crude-Murban strengthens, Oman and Dubai fall
item.description: Middle East crude benchmark Murban rallied for a third session on Wednesday, while Oman and Dubai declined. Trading activity also picked up. Strength in Murban was supported by robust demand from Asian buyers to replace U.S. supply as the arbitrage has closed. item.title: CLdN announces new container service between Rotterdam and Porto

item.title: Baltic Index Scales 2-Week Peak As Vessel Rates Rise Across All Segments
item.description: The Baltic Exchange’s dry bulk freight index, which tracks rates for vessels carrying dry bulk commodities, climbed to a two‑week high on Wednesday as rates strengthened across all vessel segments.
